description: Add a topic to the ledger before writing it: its title, the question or search phrase it is meant to win (keyword), the one product or service it is about (item), how it comes at it (angle) and which of the brand’s topics it belongs to (pillar). A keyword already covered is refused, so the same question is never written twice.

angle.description: How the piece comes at it, in a word or two of up to 60 characters: guide, comparison, checklist, story.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

item.description: The one product or service it is about, up to 120 characters.

keyword.description: The question or search phrase it is meant to win, up to 120 characters. One already covered is refused.

note.description: Anything to remember when writing it, up to 400 characters.

pillar.description: Which of the brand’s topics it belongs to, up to 120 characters.

title.description: The topic in a few words, up to 160 characters.

name: topics_add
title: Add a topic
